argus-scaling3.name: argus-scaling3
argus-scaling3.notes: CADC argus 1.0.27 from its vendor image over PostgreSQL 17 + pgsphere (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.argus.yml), serving the exported ObsCore corpus as a plain caom2.obscore table; configuration in benchmarks/tap-compare/targets/argus/, rationale in argus/PROTOCOL.md. Under scaling-three-way/pins/argus-<tier>.yml: the tier's cpuset, the 3/8 Tomcat + 5/8 PostgreSQL memory split, the vendor JVM defaults, and its UWS job store truncated before every block.

dachs-scaling3.name: dachs-scaling3
dachs-scaling3.notes: GAVO DaCHS from the Debian gavodachs2-server package (benchmarks/tap-compare/docker-compose.dachs.yml), serving the exported ObsCore corpus via //obscore#publishObscoreLike, under scaling-three-way/pins/dachs-<tier>.yml: the tier's cpus, cpuset and memory, its bundled PostgreSQL sized to the container by the 1/4 rule.

egernia-scaling3.name: egernia-scaling3
egernia-scaling3.notes: The repository's own docker-compose.yml stack (seeded with `uv run --group dataset python -m egernia_dataset.seed`, ivoa.obscore the denormalised table of PR #160, no TAP_QUERY_DATABASE_URL — one database) under scaling-three-way/pins/egernia-<tier>.yml: the tier's cpuset, memory split 1/2 db, 1/4 api, 1/4 executor, API workers 1/2/4 and PostgreSQL sized by docs/postgres-performance.md. The pins are scaling/pins/egernia-<tier>.yml byte for byte.
